text:
Aisha (oncall): FYI opening this thread to capture postmortem actions for last night's hosted inference 5xx/timeouts spike. Customer reports and internal metrics show a ~30m ramp of 502/504s across eu-west.

Marc: Confirmed — root cause looked like an aggressive autoscaler bump that led to transient auth proxy overload + connection queueing at the edge. We reverted the autoscale policy at 02:14 UTC which dropped error rate.

Priya: Customer impact: 4 customers reported timeouts (two high-volume ecom customers). Billing anomalies also flagged — some requests retried, double-charged tokens for a minority of sessions. Support tickets #1342, #1347 in the queue.

Dan: Can someone paste the minimal repro steps? I want a deterministic path to reproduce on staging.

Marc: Repro notes: send concurrent streaming requests (n=300) to /v1/generate with long-lived SSE connections (~8s prefix then large response). Use auth token from legacy proxy. Observed auth-proxy CPU spike -> backpressure -> gateway 502s. Snippet we used: ```bash
for i in $(seq 1 300); do
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://eu-west.redwood/api/v1/generate" -d '{"prompt":"lorem", "max_tokens":2000}' &
done; wait
```
Expect 10–30% 502/504 within ~20s under that load on canary config.

SRE-Bot: deploy-bot: rolled back autoscaler config redwood-prod/eu-west at 2026-02-12T02:14:12Z (run-id: deploy-7765).

Priya: Action item: Support Leads to send early notice to affected customers with credit offer and summary. I'll own credits reconciliation with finance.

Support Leads: Draft for customer comms ready, short + non-technical, offering 10% credit and postmortem summary. Per Legal we avoid saying "bug"; suggest "service degradation" phrasing.

Aisha (oncall): Ops action items I'm assigning: Marc to finish autoscaler tuning PR and add a guardrail to prevent >x%-per-minute scaleups (owner: Marc, due EOD). Dan to produce a reproducible test harness in staging (owner: Dan, due tomorrow). Priya to coordinate credits and create a follow-up with finance and support (owner: Priya, due EOD). Support Leads to send comms and update tickets (owner: Support Leads, due in 2hrs).

Marc: Note: also adding connection queue depth metrics and auth-proxy slow-request telemetry to the dashboard. Will link after PR.

Dan: I'll add a short load test script + runbook for QA to validate the guardrail. Will post link in this thread when ready.

Aisha (oncall): Postmortem doc: I created the skeleton in docs/incidents/1766543210-timeout-recovery-pm-draft.md (private). Please add technical root-cause and timeline. We'll aim for 72h postmortem publish.

Priya: Billing follow-up — flagging Finance and Billing on the tickets. Also creating tracking tag: incident-1766543210.

SRE-Bot: alert: p95 latency eu-west inference queue peaked at 3.8s between 01:50-02:20 UTC, 502 rate peaked 18%.

Support Leads: Sent customer emails to ticket list; will CC account reps.

Aisha (oncall): Any other risks? Otherwise we'll close this warroom thread and continue actions in the postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

Marc: One more risk — canary clusters still have older proxy versions; will schedule minor rolling update after autoscale guardrail merged.

Dan: Aiming to have test harness link by 10:00 UTC.

Priya: I'll post credits reconciliation steps in the postmortem doc when available.

Aisha (oncall): Thanks team. Closing live comms here — we'll track through the postmortem and assigned TODOs.
